title: Wire up or delete the dead CompletionAnimation / CompletionFeedbackController widgets
rule: Dead code (Fowler / digest 'Everything' sweep) -- feature never reaches its documented purpose

evidence.quote:
/// Animation widget shown when a completion is successfully marked.
/// In child mode: celebratory checkmark burst with confetti particles.

why: grep across all of lib/ turns up zero references to CompletionAnimation or CompletionFeedbackController outside their own definition files; the only place CompletionFeedbackController is constructed anywhere in the repo is the epic_08 story-acceptance test, which exercises the class in isolation, never through a real screen. No screen calls .start(), so the 'checkmark burst + confetti + points popup + streak bump' sequence the docstring promises never renders for any user, yet the epic_08 'Story 8.4 -- Completion Feedback & Animations' suite passes and reads as if the feature shipped and is covered.
recommendation: Either wire CompletionFeedbackController.start() into the real mark-completion flow (text_display_screen/bulk_mark_screen) and mount CompletionAnimation there, or delete both widget files plus the epic_08 Story 8.4 controller-only test groups and track the feature as not-yet-shipped.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'CompletionAnimation(\|CompletionFeedbackController(' lib/features shows a call site inside a real screen, OR the two widget files and their epic_08 groups are removed together

corrections: text_display_screen.dart imports and uses AchievementUnlockCelebration (features/gamification/presentation/widgets/achievement_unlock_celebration.dart, confetti package) plus a SnackBar for completion feedback — confirms CompletionAnimation/CompletionFeedbackController were superseded, not merely unfinished.
